name: Word or number slot roll

source.description: Three inspected references swap one word or number inside a still layout with a vertical roll (a slot, an odometer, a list scroller with a focused item).

technique: One slot of a sentence or figure rolls vertically to its next value while everything around it holds still, so the change itself is the message (what varies, what stays).
purpose: Show alternatives, growth or a list compactly; keep a headline stable while its key word changes.
visual_behaviour: The word scrolls up out of a one-line window as the next scrolls in, with a slight overshoot; widths re-centre the line.
mechanics: yPercent step of a masked column with back.out(1.5) over about 0.5 s; optional width tween so centred lines re-flow smoothly.

decomposition.timing: One roll per beat; each entry held at least about 0.6 s.

failure_modes: Entries changing faster than reading speed
Different word widths jumping without fit

limitations: Per-digit odometers (each digit its own column) are not built in; compose several rolls

provenance.observed: The last word of a line cycles through three nouns in a vertical roll (approx., from overview spacing).
A vertical list scrolls with the focused item at full strength and the others faded.
A figure counts up with rolling digits above a dotted globe (approx., from overview spacing).
Verdict pills roll vertically with blur through options and stop on the positive one.
Variant: one word changes language in place every 0.3-0.4 s through a blur crossfade (not a vertical roll) while the card holds (5.06-5.92 s).
In 'Pay anyone. Anywhere.' the currency code and the country counter change in place each beat while the headline holds (direction of the roll not resolved at the sampling used).

An odometer rolls 0 to 1,000,000 over 4.2 s (18.30-22.48 s) with digits at different speeds; later one large word of a held phrase swaps in place through a 0.25 s blur crossfade (36.9-39.02 s), a roll variant with no vertical motion.
A chart card's total rolls digit by digit to a new value when the period changes (7.7-8.5 s and 9.1-9.2 s).
A glowing step counter rolls 4,808 to 9,847 (5.6-10.1 s); a team counter rolls 0 to 100,000 over 8 s as the climb progresses (27.2-35.4 s).

A giant tabular token count changes in place with every event: 9 -> 0 between 2.50 and 3.36 s during the burst (about one step per 0.07-0.1 s), flickering 0 -> 1 -> 0 while empty (4.31-5.41 s), 2 -> 10 during recovery (7.1-11.6 s).
A dollar counter rolls with blurred digit slots to 10,000 (5.90-6.73 s), accents at 6.15 and 6.62 s.
Earnings figures roll to their values ($1.35 -> $6.75, $28.20B -> $95.72B) at 5.45-6.42 s.
A large counter rolls 66 -> 80 -> 90 -> 98 / 100 beside the opening question (3.68-4.44 s).
The earnings figure rolls $500 -> $5,000 as the slider moves, settling $4,997 -> $4,999 -> $5,000 (9.3-11.0 s).
A percentage counter rolls 00% -> 100% digit by digit over a thumbnail strip (11.3-13.0 s).

evidence.notes: Make it move / land / matter re-centres around each word.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
